anomalies.description: Three men engage in a prolonged physical fight in a restaurant: one man in white initiates an attack on a man in brown, who is then joined by a second man in white; the struggle involves grappling, throwing, and table collisions, culminating in one man being lifted and slammed.

Two individuals engage in a prolonged physical fight inside a restaurant: one in a white uniform (waiter) and another in dark clothing. The sequence shows the waiter being thrown, grappling, lifting the opponent, and using tables/chairs as part of the combat. The fight is mutual and dynamic, with both parties actively participating.; Two men engage in a physical fight inside a restaurant: one in a white suit and another in a brown shirt. The sequence shows the man in brown initiating an attack (f2–f3), throwing a chair (f4), and then both men exchanging blows, including the man in white swinging a chair (f7) and grappling (f8–f10).

Two men engage in a physical fight at a restaurant table: the man in white initiates with a punch (f0), the man in brown retaliates with a counter-punch (f1–f2), and they continue exchanging blows and grappling (f3–f11), culminating in the man in brown delivering a decisive strike that sends the other man down (f10–f11).

After the initial exchange, the man in the brown shirt continues to aggressively confront the man in the white suit, who appears stunned, recoiling and clutching his side (f11–f16), suggesting ongoing assault on a temporarily incapacitated opponent.
After the initial exchange, the man in brown continues to strike the now-fallen and defenseless man in white (f10–f12), indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
